back: DIV(a, b): whole-number quotient. MOD(a, b): remainder. DIV(17, 4) = 4, MOD(17, 4) = 1.
Brackets, then powers (^), then * and /, then + and -, left to right within a level.
A number is even when MOD(Number, 2) = 0.
= <> < <= > >=; each gives a BOOLEAN result (TRUE or FALSE).
AND: both TRUE. OR: at least one TRUE. NOT: reverses. A range check uses AND; an out-of-range check uses OR.
ROUND(value, places) rounds to that many decimal places: ROUND(3.14159, 2) = 3.14.
RANDOM() returns a real number from 0 to 1 inclusive. ROUND(RANDOM() * 5, 0) + 1 gives 1 to 6.
MOD(Number, 10) is the units digit; DIV(Number, 10) removes it.
Python: // (integer division), % (remainder), ** (power). Visual Basic: \ and Mod.
